_notes: CT-EI5BTC-M infrared thermal imaging module: 640x512 uncooled VOx detector, 12 um pixel pitch, 9.1 mm lens,
USB UVC output (YUYV, up to 50 fps). The camera for the campus flight test.
Intrinsics from the DATASHEET, not calibrated: horizontal FOV 45.7 deg gives fx = 759.4 px. The lens and pixel
pitch give the same (9.1 mm / 12 um = 758.3 px), and so does the stated vertical FOV (37.3 deg).
Treat it as nominal: the DJI M30T thermal camera has the same lens and pitch on paper, and measured 697 px,
8% less. A focal length error moves every point by that fraction of its distance from the image centre.
cx, cy default to the image centre; no distortion model. Calibrate before trusting sub-metre numbers.
Not radiometric: it gives a picture, not temperatures, so localization uses Otsu (no absolute mode).
Use the white-hot palette: grey level then rises with temperature, which Otsu needs.
Pose does not come from this camera: process_video.py takes it from a telemetry CSV, so there are no
metadata_fields. How the camera is mounted on the drone decides where its yaw and pitch come from.
name: CT-EI5BTC-M thermal (9.1 mm)
